name: zing
description: A privacy-first Chromium browser for Windows.

scripts.gen:host-defaults: rolldown scripts/gen-host-defaults.ts --platform node --format esm --file out/gen-host-defaults.mjs && node out/gen-host-defaults.mjs
scripts.gen:reader: rolldown scripts/reader-entry.ts --format iife --file host/Zing.Host/Assets/reader.js && rolldown scripts/gen-reader.ts --platform node --format esm --file out/gen-reader.mjs && node out/gen-reader.mjs
scripts.gen:notices: rolldown scripts/gen-notices.ts --platform node --format esm --file out/gen-notices.mjs && node out/gen-notices.mjs
scripts.build:host: npm run gen:reader && npm run gen:notices && dotnet build host/Zing.Host -c Release
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:host && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:real-input: npm run build && npm run build:host && playwright test --grep @real-input
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:host && "host\Zing.Host\bin\Release\net9.0-windows10.0.26100.0\win-x64\Zing.exe"
